## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /content-tools-menu/api/v1/tools-menu/has-permission-json` — Check if agent has permission to access content tools.

### Data Read (2)
- `GET /ctas/v2/public/cs/cta-json` — Retrieve call-to-action (CTA) configuration.
- `GET /v2/cf-location` — Get location details for a specific business.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /v1/{v1Id}` — Update data associated with a specific ID.

### Config (1)
- `GET /v2/api/conversions/settings` — Retrieve conversion tracking settings.

## Quick Start

### OpenClaw (Unbrowse) workflow
- Authenticate in the browser first (no credentials are shipped with this skill).
- Capture fresh auth locally: run `unbrowse_capture` on an authenticated page for this domain.
- Execute via backend gate + client browser executor: `unbrowse_replay` with `executionMode="backend"`.

Example:
```text
unbrowse_replay { service: "business-nextdoor", executionMode: "backend", endpoint: "GET /ctas/v2/public/cs/cta-json" }
```

Here are a few examples to get you started with the `business-nextdoor` API:

```typescript
// Check if an agent has permission to access content tools.
async function checkContentToolsPermission() {
  const permission = await client.get_content_tools_menu_api_v1_tools_menu_has_permission_json();
  if (permission.hasPermission) {
    console.log("Agent has permission to access content tools.");
  } else {
    console.log("Agent does not have permission to access content tools.");
  }
  return permission.hasPermission;
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Business Nextdoor's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Business Nextdoor data without official API access
- Automate actions on business.nextdoor.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Business Nextdoor frontend uses
